text: Some days I work hard. || Then I remember... || This is what I am buying back.
I finally learned to slow down by the ocean.
The airport wait is part of the anticipation. || Then the airplane takes over.
A mountain view makes room for a different perspective.
Another stretch of road. || Another afternoon by the ocean.
No motivation. Still showed up for training.
One workout cannot do everything. || But it is still progress.
The work is quiet. || The progress takes time.
A run starts with the first step. || Keep practicing.
A little more care in today's work.
Coffee first. || A moment to breathe next.
An ordinary quiet afternoon at home is enough.
Make time to enjoy the meal.
An ordinary day with friends is worth keeping.
